versions.changelog:
- Now only activates when the user explicitly requests project documentation—won't auto-trigger on ordinary project conversation.
- Added a consent warning: clarifies that the skill writes/edits only PROJECT.md, never runs shell commands, and prompts for project root confirmation.
- Removed the ability to use the exec tool; skill now operates with least privilege (read/write/edit only).
- Expanded rules and usage guidance to emphasize consent, explicit invocation, and safety.
- Documentation and metadata updated to version 1.1 with clearer descriptions and restrictions.
- Added .clawhub/origin.json and _meta.json; removed obsolete skill-card.md.

- Initial release of project-doc-skill (version 1.0.0).
- Creates or updates a PROJECT.md as the single source of truth for any project.
- Uses a quiz-first workflow to tailor the doc to the specific project and type (app, CLI, web, library, data, infra, or generic).
- Ensures the doc includes purpose, stack, how to build/run, structure, key decisions, changelog, and notes log.
- Never overwrites existing PROJECT.md files without reading and updating them; always updates via conversation.
- Designed for ongoing maintenance, not just one-time creation.
